waves.title: key.wave.1
waves.note: Rule (b) honoured: first wave of any level ALWAYS <=40% of par (§1.7). Cold Start Minute governs the first 90s of sim-time: handover no threat, one FREE conversion, signature constraint asserts harmlessly with telegraph (§1.9). On this line the harmless assertion is a drizzle of survey teams walking the fence line and measuring your skew from the parking lot — the quarter opens with a perfect row of identical coils and the only strangers paying attention to them are the ones with clipboards (§1.3's meter stick, §0.3's trading-firm tenants still touring).

waves.title: key.wave.2
waves.note: Rising floor beat one — the ROUTINE catastrophe, and it is a tenant winning. Two-Front (§2.24): the compliance-mimic (Mimic — 'a tenant who finds an unfair advantage', §1.3 verbatim; the registry's crowd-hider re-framed onto a floor whose whole product is visible identicality) spends concurrency against the shared trunk, while the griefer (Mimic — the registry's ONE fairness-cheating customer entry, lookalike law OD-18: it masks as a game-player-joining archetype because cheating is excitement resold) spends reputation on every tenant who ordered the same metre. The coil diameters still match. The numbers do not. That is the lesson of wave two: fairness enforced by spool is fairness enforced on the spool — the threat lives downstream of the visible contract.
waves.entropyNote: entropy budget here = f(estate age x size x (1 - maintenance spend)), NOT wave number (§2.24) — on this line maintenance spend IS the survey cadence, and the card prices it twice: the meter-stick dial as the purchase, the publicized breach as the unforgiven version (§1.3).

waves.title: key.wave.3
waves.note: Rule (c): 30% is 50% below the preceding peak (60%) — >=45% satisfied. Dips are where the player builds (§1.7): the spool equalizer, the label board, the audit trail all get their window here. But on the exchange-colo line the quiet is the bill: the residents live there, the phantom cabinets hold amps against a ramp nobody started, and the busy wall goes grey one hexagon at a time — '16 empty cabinets of stranded capacity for a year' (§6.x ramp law verbatim). Two fronts: concurrency x reputation — the hoarder's dark rows read as headroom while the spiral makes the emptiness itself the story the tours stop telling.

waves.title: key.wave.4
waves.note: Compound-wave exemplar, exchange-colo variant: the remediation calendar lands the audit calendar — a batch re-spool day walks every rack on the floor (Splitter debuts here, the every-4th-wave NEW ROLE beat; unseen in waves 1-3, the registry's only purchased-batch mechanic reused per this line's threat-mapping law), every 'compliance fix' a coin flip against the identicality contract — and inside the same window the regulator's paperwork avalanche hits the NOC (Swarm on hands), because a floor mid-rewrap is exactly when cable lengths stop matching the ledgers that promise they do. Two fronts: data-integrity (the invariant itself — measured equality, tonight measured only in hindsight) x hands (the audit does not queue politely; 'the regulator who audits your cable lengths', §1.3 verbatim).
waves.secondIncident: audit-request avalanche arrives inside the re-spool incident window -> 1.8x multiplier applies (stated openly in the Codex, §2.24).

waves.title: key.wave.5
waves.note: The finale is the identicality contract made public property: the hidden advantage is discovered (Parasite carry — the reflection of one unaudited tenant's unsecured gear lands on the whole building's standing; the registry's reputation-reflection re-framed per bundle threats._todo), the riot arrives as instruments not fists (Swarm — disputed invoices, chargebacks, 'angry client sprites with lawyers', §1.3 verbatim), and the spiral keeps darkening the floor the tours now have to explain (Healer/Spawner) — every dark hexagon somebody's competitor's success story. Hard wave draws TWO fronts — reputation x cash — per §2.24: the building's word and the tenants' counter-word, spending the company from both sides at once. Win check: the skew held at zero long enough that the audit report read like a boring document, while the row of coils stayed a row.
waves.triageWindow: after any catastrophic failure in this wave: arrivals queue visibly outside, patience draining, hands freed 30s (§1.7).
